remarks: Welcome to this bright and spacious 1-bedroom, 1-bath apartment located on the 7th floor of a well-maintained high-rise in the heart of Stamford's Glenbrook neighborhood. Offering approximately 754 square feet of living space, this freshly painted unit features a large living and dining area with partial skyline views, a generously sized bedroom with ample closet space, and a kitchen with cherry wood cabinetry and classic finishes. The bathroom is clean and functional with vintage charm. Residents enjoy the convenience of shared laundry on the same floor and one assigned parking space. Ideally situated just minutes from downtown Stamford, Metro-North, I-95, restaurants, shopping, and parks, this apartment provides easy access to everything the city has to offer. Heat, hot water, and cooking gas included. A great opportunity for anyone seeking comfort, space, and location at an unbeatable value!
